title: a `lang: pdl` block whose program does not parse
notes: The inner diagnostic now arrives intact under a one-line header (`the PDL program in this `code:` block is not valid`), with a note that `<program:...#code>:N` counts lines of the block's code. Every newline that the `repr` used to escape is a real line again, so the inner excerpt, carets, rule and help all render. Location 2: the outer header has the block's file:line:col and path, the inner one is in the nested program's own coordinates.
